description: Trilogy Hub server - multiplayer for GTA: San Andreas - The Definitive Edition. The server program is downloaded from the official signed releases on the first start and updates itself.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Trilogy Hub - installation (runs in the installer container, server files are in /mnt/server)
set -e
REPO="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abs0lw3nt/TrilogyHub-Hosting/main"
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
curl -fsSL "$REPO/start.js" -o start.js
curl -fsSL "$REPO/start.sh" -o start.sh
chmod +x start.sh
if [ ! -f server-config.json ]; then
  curl -fsSL "$REPO/server-config.example.json" -o server-config.json
fi
# reinstall = fresh server program from the latest release on the next start; config and resources stay
rm -f TrilogyHubServer
echo "Trilogy Hub: installation finished. The server program is downloaded and verified on the first start."
